base_url.correction: No hosted Space Cloud base URL remains. Space Cloud organizations were disabled on June 1, 2025; surviving on-premises instances use https://<instance-host>/api/http.

free_tier.correction: false for the hosted API; Space Cloud subscriptions ended. Previously licensed Space On-Premises customers may continue using their instances for free.

free_tier_limits.correction: Not applicable to Space Cloud because no active cloud tier remains; legacy on-premises use depends on the previously updated perpetual license.

example.correction: The example's jetbrains.space cloud host is no longer usable. Any request must target a surviving self-hosted instance and should be generated or verified through that instance's API Playground.

description.correction: JetBrains Space Cloud was discontinued and its organizations were disabled on June 1, 2025. Only previously licensed Space On-Premises installations may continue operating indefinitely.

notes: The entry is obsolete as a public hosted API listing. JetBrains retained the old API documentation, but Space Cloud and its organization-specific jetbrains.space endpoints were disabled in 2025. Existing perpetual on-premises installations are the only surviving deployment path.
